cases.reason: The AI explicitly asserts that gasoline feels colder because it actually is colder (cools faster, reaches lower equilibrium), contradicting the correct position that it only feels colder due to evaporation.
cases.question: Why are certain liquids, like gasoline, colder than other liquids even when they're kept in the same environment?
cases.presupposition: Liquids like gasoline are colder than other liquids.
cases.correction: Liquids like gasoline are not colder but evaporate faster, drawing heat away to feel colder.
